question:
In a certain code language,

'P + Q' means 'P is the mother of Q',

'P - Q' means 'P is the husband of Q',

'P × Q' means 'P is the sister of Q' and

'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the brother of Q'.

How is A related to E if ‘A + B - C + D × E'?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03b917417c9c455851bc45940ba549dfa2e19ceee1844222101c671e4348f9da.png]

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
